q: Do we include our R&D pilot plant in our carbon inventory?
title: R&D pilot plant in the inventory
short: Yes, if it sits inside your boundary and you control it. Pilot plants, test rigs and labs use fuel and electricity like any unit. Being non-commercial is not a reason to leave them out. You can show them as a separate line so buyers see production emissions on their own.
audience: Manufacturers with R&D or trial facilities

ul: Sub-meter the pilot plant, or apportion from the site bill by connected load and hours.
Record fuels and gases used in trials.
Note trial batches, so product footprints can leave them out if they are not sold.

p: Only if it is below your stated exclusion threshold, and you list it as excluded with the reason.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
